\begin{document}
For real $x$ and integers $n$ and $m$ we use
\begin{equation}
x^n x^m = x^{n+m} .
\label{eq:pow}
\end{equation}
and
\begin{equation}
x^{n} \cdot x = x^{n+1} .
\label{eq:pow2}
\end{equation}
The partition function of $N$ independent spins is
\begin{equation}
(1+x)^N (1+x)^M = (1+x)^{N+M}
\label{eq:pow3}
\end{equation}
